M0.8.fit_order: non-monotone, scatter about +-1 % for wall_size <= 5 mm

farfield_sensitivity: farfield_sensitivity.csv: M0.8 alpha 4, CN within 0.25 % for 10, 20, 40 body lengths

rans_case.note: older run (half model, alpha 0 offset subtracted, before the z-symmetric mesh); no boundary-layer prisms; SA + standard wall function, first-order Roe, 300 iteration cap

memory.model: 40 MB per rank + 3.3 kB per cell (Euler, summed over ranks)
